summary.text: Brian D. Miller is the incumbent Republican and Conservative Party candidate for New York State Assembly District 122 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A mechanical engineer and former Oneida County legislator, he was first elected to the Assembly in 2016.

paragraphs.text: Miller graduated from Mohawk Valley Community College and, according to his official biography, has more than 36 years of experience as a mechanical engineer.

From 2000 to 2016 he served as an Oneida County legislator for the 16th district, where he chaired the Public Works Committee and was Assistant Majority Leader, and he spent eight years as Bridgewater Town Supervisor.
Miller was elected to the Assembly on November 8, 2016, and represents parts of Oneida, Herkimer, Otsego and Madison counties.

His official biography describes him as the Assembly's Chairman of the Steering Committee and Ranking Minority Member of the Transportation Committee; the Assembly's committee page lists him as a member of the Agriculture, Consumer Affairs and Protection, Education, Higher Education, Real Property Taxation and Transportation committees.
He lives in New Hartford with his wife, Dawn, and their son, according to his official biography.
